source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 15 octombrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Savin, Episcopul Ciprului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Σαβίνος ο επίσκοπος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: pressed to take a bishop's throne against his wish for the monastic life, made excellent in works of charity but unable to bear the wear of administration, who resigned and went back to the desert life of his cell and was given the gift of wonders. **The line itself gives him no see** — it is «Όσιος Σαβίνος ο επίσκοπος», the bishop, and nothing more — and the page's own closing note is where Cyprus comes from: «Σημείωση: Ο Παρισινός Κώδικας 1578 τον αναφέρει σαν επίσκοπο Κύπρου», the Paris Codex 1578 refers to him as bishop of Cyprus. That is a citation of a manuscript and not a statement of the calendar's own, so nothing is changed on the folder's epithet and no `office` is proposed here. No year, so no `dates`; no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
